focus: Source/test review of RealityKit orbit/selection adapter, StudioView routing and Intel simulator fallback before RealityKit resource construction. Entity mesh transforms, AR features and already-reviewed SceneKit fit excluded.

actual_paths.review_scope: Preview routing, generation guards, Fit action, busy-state context
Test inventory and adapter coverage boundary
Fallback coordinator creation, callback refresh and selection only; fit excluded
Selection ID lookup/registry only; mesh transforms excluded

checks.result: Source confirms #if targetEnvironment(simulator) && arch(x86_64) selects SpatialPreview directly, and previewNote uses the corresponding guarded branch. RealityStudioSurface.makeCoordinator and its eager StudioEntityGraph/RealityKit resources are not reached through this route.

Reality coordinator refreshes onSelect on every update, validates currentScene, resolves a hit through the current light-root registry, and checks currentScene membership. StudioView verifies current library generation and live UUID membership; .id(generation) replaces the adapter at project-generation changes. Removed light roots are dropped from the lookup map. Fallback also refreshes its callback before the update early return and verifies live light membership.

Orbit/pan/zoom use incremental finite gesture values and bounded pitch, target and distance. Ordinary scene or selection updates retain orbit; changed fitRequest sets needsFit. Rendering attaches only for active window state; detach clears callbacks, targets, gestures and anchors. Gesture gate rejects invalid scenes and VoiceOver; pan/pinch alone recognize simultaneously.

SpatialPreviewTests contains three SceneKit-focused methods: translated projection fit, ordinary-edit orbit preservation/explicit Fit, and empty/extreme fit plus physical camera mode. These do not exercise the RealityKit adapter, tap selection, or the compile-time Intel routing branch. Test source was reviewed, not executed.

AGENTS, all named startup documents and m02-m03-code-v2 acceptance contract read remotely at the fixed base SHA. M03 remains active in checked state; source review does not establish native/UI acceptance.

limitations: Host unavailable; no scripts, builds, tests, UI gestures, simulator rendering or device execution performed.
No runtime pass, native/UI milestone acceptance, physical calibration, performance, platform audit or release-readiness claim.
The assigned native test file supplies no direct regression coverage for RealityKit callback/gesture lifecycle or compile-time fallback routing; runtime behavior remains unverified by this review.
Review was scoped to assigned adapter/routing concerns; mesh transforms, AR and SceneKit camera-fit correctness were deliberately excluded.

RealityStudioSurface does not read SwiftUI isEnabled while the SceneKit fallback does; the StudioView callback blocks busy-state selection, and this review did not establish a material user-visible failure from viewport gestures during busy state.
conclusion: No concrete must-fix defect identified in the assigned source review. Intel fallback construction ordering and current-scene/generation selection guards are sound by inspection; missing runtime/direct adapter evidence remains explicit.
